reasoning_traces.think:
The promotion system is modeled as a structured compliance-driven revenue pipeline. Each partner is assigned a trust level (P0/P1/P2), which determines whether their offers are enabled. The system uses a disabled-by-default data model to ensure all offers undergo administrative review before activation. Offers are subject to geo-temporal validity constraints, enforced via a discrete-time geolocation filter. The system ensures that no live links are exposed without explicit approval and that disclosures are made in accordance with FTC guidelines. This structure prevents unauthorized revenue generation while maintaining a scalable framework for future integrations. The failure mode occurs when a partner’s trust level is misclassified or when geo-temporal constraints are bypassed, leading to non-compliant exposure. The dual nature of this system lies in its ability to balance monetization with regulatory adherence through a layered validation mechanism.
